headline: Marcos Administration Satisfaction Rating Rebounds to Neutral +1 in SWS Survey
seoTitle: Marcos Administration Rating Rebounds to Neutral +1 in SWS Survey
seoDescription: The Marcos administration's net satisfaction rating rose 14 points from -13 in March to a neutral +1 in June, according to SWS.
deck: The Marcos administration's net satisfaction rating rose 14 points from -13 in March to a neutral +1 in June, according to Social Weather Stations.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The Marcos administration's net satisfaction rating recovered to neutral territory in June 2026, according to a Social Weather Stations survey reported by ABS-CBN News on Wednesday.
The net score rose 14 points to +1 from -13 in March. SWS classifies scores from +9 to -9 as neutral.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Net satisfaction is calculated by subtracting the percentage of dissatisfied respondents from the percentage who are satisfied. A change in the net score shows movement in the balance of opinion, not unanimous approval or disapproval.
The result evaluates the national administration as a whole and should not be treated as a separate job-approval rating for every official or agency.

sections.heading: Why this matters to Filipinos
paragraphs: Public-opinion surveys provide a snapshot of how adults assess government performance at a given time. They can influence political debate, but they do not replace elections, official performance data or policy outcomes.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for the full SWS release, including its sampling method, error margins and regional breakdowns, and for subsequent surveys showing whether the rebound is sustained.
